dataset: Per-instance outputs of AHELM (HELM audio) suite v1.0.0, Stanford CRFM: every run listed on the run-group pages librispeech, librispeech_fairness, multilingual_librispeech, fleurs, fleurs_fairness, speech_robust_bench, ami, first trial. note: An output is empty when its text is empty after strip(); HELM's wer/mer/cer (and chinese_*) then return 0, the best value. Corrected = the same mean with each empty output valued 1.0 (jiwer's value for an empty hypothesis; the fix proposed in HELM issue #4359 and PR #4361). A headline cell is the mean of its runs' wer_score means. P2 >= 1 empty output and every one has a published 0; P3 >= 50% of empty outputs come from Gemini models; P4 empty outputs <= 1% of records; P5 at least one headline WER cell rises by >= 0.01; P6 at least one model changes rank in a group table; P7 no included run has more than one reference per instance on average.
